statement: When a guard keeps a CI gate honest, check the invariant the gate depends on, not a list of known softening flags. 2026-11-17: after #735 and two review rounds, cejel's workflow-lint guard refused about fifteen named softenings of zizmor. It still passed `if: ${{ false }}` on the zizmor step, which skips the lint entirely, and a step that empties action/action.yml before zizmor runs. Each new list entry closed one route; the invariant closed the class. In #739 the guard runs directly before zizmor and checks with git that HEAD is $GITHUB_SHA and the working tree is clean, ignored files included. The workflow may carry no if:, no shell: and no action beyond checkout and setup-node. Before trusting a gate, write the invariant it relies on (here: the commit, unmodified, fully linted), check that invariant at run time, and keep enumeration for what cannot be checked at run time.
